name: clarify-done-version-bump-skip-runtime-scope
title: Clarify DONE version-bump skip reason for non-runtime code changes
description: Fix the misleading DONE post-merge version-bump skip wording exposed by B-63ba. The current behavior correctly limits CLI package version bumps to watched CLI/runtime inputs, but the visible skip line says no material code change even when non-runtime experiment code changed. Clarify the runtime-input boundary in code, tests, and lifecycle docs without expanding the CLI version policy arbitrarily.
